generalProvisions: This bill amends provisions relating to business entities.
highlightedProvisions: This bill:<hr><ltbullet>defines terms;<hr><ltbullet>lists the areas of code the Division of Corporations and Commercial Code (division) administers;<hr><ltbullet>provides that the division shall offer to sell or license a copy of each document filed with the division under certain conditions;<hr><ltbullet>enacts Title 16, Chapter 1a, Provisions Applicable to All Business Entities;<hr><ltbullet>establishes standardized entity filing requirements for all business entities;<hr><ltbullet>provides that the division may provide forms for an entity filing;<hr><ltbullet>establishes a standard for the effective date and time of an entity filing;<hr><ltbullet>provides the circumstances under which a person may withdraw an entity filing before effectiveness;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the standards for correcting an entity filing;<hr><ltbullet>provides that the division has a duty to file an entity filing that complies with certain standards;<hr><ltbullet>establishes signing requirements for an entity filing;<hr><ltbullet>provides for liability for a person that provides inaccurate information in a filed record;<hr><ltbullet>provides the manner by which the division may deliver a record to a person;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for an entity's annual report to the division;<hr><ltbullet>establishes standards for permissible names for an entity;<hr><ltbullet>provides the name requirements for specific entities;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process by which a person may reserve an entity name;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which a foreign filing entity may register a name;<hr><ltbullet>provides which business entities are required to maintain a registered agent in this state;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process for designating a registered agent;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process for the listing of a commercial registered agent;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process for the termination of the listing of a commercial registered agent;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which a represented entity may change the represented entity's registered agent;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which a noncommercial registered agent may change the noncommercial registered agent's name or address;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process by which a commercial registered agent may change the commercial registered agent's name, address, type of entity, or jurisdiction of formation;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which a registered agent may resign as a registered agent;<hr><ltbullet>provides how a person may make service of process, notice, or demand on an entity;<hr><ltbullet>describes the duties of a registered agent;<hr><ltbullet>provides that a foreign entity shall register with the division to do business in this state;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for filing and amending a foreign registration statement;<hr><ltbullet>provides that certain activities of a foreign entity do not constitute doing business in this state;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which a foreign entity may adopt an alternate name that complies with the name requirements of this state;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which a registered foreign entity may withdraw the registered foreign entity's registration with the division;<hr><ltbullet>provides for a transfer of a registered foreign entity's registration under certain conditions;<hr><ltbullet>provides the conditions and manner under which the division may terminate a registered foreign entity's registration;<hr><ltbullet>provides the grounds under which the division may administratively dissolve a domestic filing entity;<hr><ltbullet>provides the procedure and effect of an administrative dissolution of a domestic filing entity;<hr><ltbullet>provides the conditions under which and process by which a domestic filing entity may be reinstated after administrative dissolution;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which an entity may take part in a merger;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for a plan of merger;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements to approve a plan of merger;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process for amending or abandoning a plan of merger;<hr><ltbullet>provides that a merging entity sign a statement of merger;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the effect of a merger;<hr><ltbullet>provides that an interest holder in an entity that undergoes a merger, conversion, or domestication has appraisal rights;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which an entity may take part in an interest exchange;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for a plan of interest exchange;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements to approve a plan of interest exchange;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process for amending or abandoning a plan of interest exchange;<hr><ltbullet>provides that an acquired entity sign a statement of interest exchange;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the effect of an interest exchange;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which an entity may take part in a conversion;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for a plan of conversion;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements to approve a plan of conversion;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process for amending or abandoning a plan of conversion;<hr><ltbullet>provides that a converting entity sign a statement of conversion;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the effect of a conversion;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process by which an entity may take part in a domestication;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for a plan of domestication;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements to approve a plan of domestication;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the process for amending or abandoning a plan of domestication;<hr><ltbullet>provides that a merging entity sign a statement of domestication;<hr><ltbullet>establishes the effect of a domestication;<hr><ltbullet>renumbers Title 48, Chapter 1d, Utah Uniform Partnership Act, to Title 16, Chapter 18, Utah Uniform Partnership Act;<hr><ltbullet>renumbers Title 48, Chapter 2e, Utah Uniform Limited Partnership Act, to Title 16, Chapter 19, Utah Uniform Limited Partnership Act;<hr><ltbullet>renumbers Title 48, Chapter 3a, Utah Revised Uniform Limited Liability Company Act, to Title 16, Chapter 20, Utah Revised Uniform Limited Liability Company Act;<hr><ltbullet>changes references in code from "assumed name" to "D.B.A.";<hr><ltbullet>provides what the name of a D.B.A. may contain;<hr><ltbullet>provides the standards for registering as a D.B.A.;<hr><ltbullet>provides the process for amending a D.B.A. certificate;<hr><ltbullet>provides the manner by which a D.B.A. may transfer ownership;<hr><ltbullet>provides the expiration, renewal, and cancellation of a registration process for a D.B.A.;<hr><ltbullet>provides penalties for a person that transacts business as a D.B.A. without complying with Title 42, Chapter 2, Conducting Business as a D.B.A.;<hr><ltbullet>repeals provisions in existing code that the enactment of Title 16, Chapter 1a, Provisions Applicable to All Business Entities, makes redundant; and<hr><ltbullet>makes technical and conforming changes.
